it.example_en: Had I known about it, I would have told you.

item.meaning: n. 项目, 条款, 一则, 项
item.example_en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.

items.meaning: n. 项目；名目；所有物品（item的复数形式）
items.example_en: There, pandas have been trained to perform dozens of items.
